$comment: ADR-344 distance-based journey preparation for AI humans (ai/journey.ts, ai/travel.ts). A bot setting out on a long trip packs food / water / gear sized to the estimated trip before it leaves, from its own storage — or its employer's, for hired workers (the same mayTakeFromStorage rules as ADR-323/327/342) — taking only the surplus above the per-item reserve, so the base is never starved. The estimate uses the off-screen travel speeds (travel.json: 2.6 tiles/s on foot, 5.4 mounted) plus budgeted rest stops; food / water needs come from the vitals.json drain rates (hunger 0.05/s, thirst 0.08/s) times safetyMargin. A bot whose packed provisions run out mid-trip turns back toward home instead of pressing on: the off-screen needsFloor (50) stays as the survival last resort — the bot forages enough to live, not enough to continue — so the turn-back keys off provision points, not vitals. Trips shorter than minPrepTiles need no preparation and get no turn-back rule. departMinHunger / departMinThirst mirror autonomy's hungry cutoffs (55 / 60): a bot below them eats and drinks first and the trip waits, bounded by prepDeadlineTicks. longTripTiles mirrors mounts.json longTripTiles (mountPolicy mounts for longer trips).
